146.reason: Preserve the source's operational concern about alert noise while distinguishing false-positive rate from false-alert proportion. Both require a defensible reference classification and a defined observation window.

zh.text: 若 SOC 要評估分析師收到的告警有多少是雜訊，可另量測告警中的誤報比例 FP/(TP+FP)，而不是套用 FPR 名稱。兩項量測都需要清楚的觀察期間、案件判定依據與分母；只對告警案件抽樣，通常無法直接取得全部 TN，也就不能單憑該抽樣估計完整 FPR。

en.text: To assess how much of the alert queue is noise, a SOC can separately measure the false-alert proportion FP/(TP+FP), rather than label it FPR. Both measures require a defined observation period, reference classification and denominator. Sampling only alerted cases generally does not establish all true negatives and therefore cannot, by itself, estimate the full FPR.
